notes: Event date: 10 May 1945 (MacDonald, ch. 20); Wikipedia: final ceremony at Bouvron at noon on 11 May. Event definition: The garrison surrenders on 10 May to the US 66th Infantry Division (MacDonald, ch. 20); Wikipedia has an agreement at Cordemais on 8 May and the final ceremony at Bouvron on 11 May. Event support: two source families (the US Army official history (CMH), and Wikipedia). MacDonald, The Last Offensive, ch. 20, p. 477: "The garrisons of Lorient and St. Nazaire on the coast of Brittany surrendered on 10 May"; Wikipedia, Saint-Nazaire pocket: "The final surrender ceremony took place at noon that day at the Grand Clos racecourse in Bouvron". Location: Saint-Nazaire, Loire-Atlantique (new place) with a precision of 5 km. Location support: MacDonald names St. Nazaire; Wikipedia names Bouvron for the ceremony. Opponents: US 66th Infantry Division.
